INSERT INTO ${collection} ( data_id, subject_id, subject_type, action, attributes ) VALUES ( #{dataId}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectType}, #{action}, #{attributes} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE subject_type = #{subjectType}, action = #{action}, attributes = #{attributes}
mapper.select:
WITH data AS ( SELECT DISTINCT data.* FROM ${dataCollection} data LEFT JOIN ${authCollection} auth ON data.id = auth.data_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND data.id IN
#{id}
AND data.id = #{dataInfo.id}
AND data.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dataInfo.name}, '%')
AND data.type = #{dataInfo.type}
AND data.folder = #{dataInfo.folder}
AND data.`case` = #{dataInfo.cs}
AND data.template = #{dataInfo.template}
AND data.system = #{dataInfo.system}
AND data.shared = #{dataInfo.shared}
AND (
data.owner_id = #{ownerId}
1 = 1
OR (auth.subject_id = #{userId} AND auth.subject_type = 1)
OR (auth.subject_id = #{departmentId} AND auth.subject_type = 2)
OR ( auth.subject_id IN
#{teamId}
AND auth.subject_type = 3 )
)
AND data.owner_id = #{dataInfo.ownerId}
AND data.owner_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dataInfo.ownerName}, '%')
AND data.department_id = #{dataInfo.departmentId}
AND (JSON_CONTAINS(data.teams, CONCAT('["', #{dataInfo.teamId}, '"]')))
AND data.created_at >= STR_TO_DATE(#{dataInfo.createdStartStr}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND data.created_at <= STR_TO_DATE(#{dataInfo.createdEndStr}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND data.updated_at >= STR_TO_DATE(#{dataInfo.updatedStartStr}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND data.updated_at <= STR_TO_DATE(#{dataInfo.updatedEndStr}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND data.deleted_at IS NULL
AND data.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
) SELECT 0 AS none
,id AS id
,name AS name
,image AS image
,data AS dataJsonStr
,type AS type
,folder AS folder
,`case` AS cs
,template AS template
,`system` AS `system`
,shared AS shared
,recommend AS recommend
,owner_id AS ownerId
,owner_name AS ownerName
,editor_id AS editorId
,editor_name AS editorName
,department_id AS departmentId
,teams AS teams
,DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt
,DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt
,DATE_FORMAT(deleted_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS deletedAt
FROM data
ORDER BY ${sort}
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{current}
